description: Mark the deploys list as paginated. The spec documents the `links` this list returns (its `TimeSeriesLinks` schema) but marks no operation as paginated, so it was a single-page call. listDeploys (GET /projects/{project_id}/deploys) pages from newest to oldest: `links.older` is the next page (`?before=...&limit=M`), null when nothing older exists. The trait names that link (outputToken) and the query parameter that holds the position (inputToken); paginateHoneybadger in src/pagination.ts copies that parameter from the link into the next request. A time-ordered request with only `after` asks for what is newer, and its `links.older` would lead back past that point, so paginateHoneybadger follows `links.newer` (`?after=...&limit=M`, null when nothing newer exists) instead. Source: the published spec, https://docs.honeybadger.io/api/v3/openapi.json. Checked live on 2026-11-20: from the middle page's `links.newer` cursor, the forward walk returned exactly the newer deploys and ended at `links.newer: null`.
